headline: OceanaGold Receives Ausgold Shareholder Approval for Acquisition
summary: OceanaGold Corporation announced that Ausgold Limited shareholders voted in favour of the scheme of arrangement for the acquisition.
why: Mergers and acquisitions alter corporate structures and can reshape market positions for mining companies.

impacts.name: OceanaGold Corporation
impacts.why: OceanaGold is acquiring Ausgold under the approved scheme of arrangement.
